subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose restart catch-up controls in public cron config, and should the supported shape be the existing global max/stagger knobs, a skip/catch-up policy, or no new public config?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but root policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and the choice changes restart semantics for existing scheduled jobs.

options.title: Expose narrow global controls
options.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up controls using the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit disable semantics for a zero immediate limit.

options.title: Design a skip policy first
options.body: Choose a global or per-job skipMissedRuns-style policy before implementation while preserving current catch-up defaults for existing users.

options.title: Keep controls internal
options.body: Decline new public config for now and document current restart catch-up behavior and operational workarounds instead.

recommendation.title: Expose narrow global controls
recommendation.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up controls using the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit disable semantics for a zero immediate limit.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete landed the original internal restart catch-up change and authored adjacent startup catch-up refactoring, so this is the strongest available route for the config/product decision.
